players.product: SiC MOSFETs and GaN devices for 800V HVDC AI power

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April - September 2025) results: net sales JPY 244,228 million, up 5.3% year on year despite a stronger yen, on sharply higher consumer-market sales; operating income JPY 7,653 million (H1 FY2025: operating loss JPY 974 million) on higher sales and the prior year's fixed-cost savings; ordinary profit JPY 13,422 million; net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 10,318 million (+398.9%). Segments: LSI JPY 114,218 million (+9.6%), segment profit JPY 12,955 million (+134.2%); Semiconductor Devices JPY 99,980 million (+2.8%), segment loss JPY 9,809 million (H1 FY2025: loss JPY 10,417 million); Modules JPY 17,137 million (-3.4%), profit JPY 2,430 million; Other JPY 12,891 million (+0.8%), profit JPY 2,057 million. H1 R&D spending JPY 22,791 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 244,228 million (+5.3%); operating income JPY 7,653 million

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 SiC and operations: SiC device sales for automotive xEV held firm and SiC substrate sales showed recovery in the second quarter, but this did not offset a customer-driven sales decline in the first quarter, so SiC power device sales overall fell in H1. Management states that after product and work-in-process inventories were reduced in the prior year, factory utilisation is improving, while raw material inventories are still being optimised.
